about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Introduction
about.text: I am a Software & Web Developer with 3+ years hands‑on experience across fintech, telecom, and SaaS projects. I'm driven by integrity, responsibility, and collaborative problem‑solving. I have delivered attendance & leave automation, KPI evaluation modules, QR‑verified document workflows, meeting room booking, and multi‑source data validation services using Golang, Vue.js, React, Laravel, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs. I enjoy turning product ideas into performant, maintainable code and optimizing data flows (streaming & transactional). I'm seeking the next challenge where pragmatic engineering, clean interfaces, and reliable data integration create measurable impact.
